You get a set menu built to your headcount, a vetted chef and a service team who handle the food, the room and the clear-down, leaving you free to entertain your guests. new_paragraphs: The corporate dinner package menu is built with you, not handed down — you pick a cuisine and a service style, and the chef shapes courses around your guests and the season. Popular formats include a three-course plated dinner, a chef-attended buffet, or grazing and canapé rounds for stand-up events. Cuisines span Italian and Mediterranean, Arabic and Levantine, Indian, pan-Asian and modern European, and every menu can be built fully halal on request. Dietary requirements — vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut-free and allergy-aware plates — are handled in the menu design, not improvised at the table. If you would like to taste before you commit, a formal tasting menu is available from AED 1,400 so decision-makers can sign off the dishes in advance. The result is corporate dinner package food that suits your specific room, not a fixed sheet you have to work around.

On the day the chef arrives ahead of service, sets up, cooks or plates, runs the meal to your schedule and clears down afterwards. If dinners recur, we set up an ongoing arrangement with consistent menus and a single, tidy invoice, so you are not re-briefing a new corporate dinner package catering services team every quarter. A team celebration usually wants a relaxed buffet or grazing-style spread that keeps people mingling; a client dinner leans plated and precise, where timing and presentation do the talking. For a company party we scale the corporate dinner package party catering to the room, adding live stations or a bar so the evening has a centre of gravity. Larger corporate dinner package catering for events — awards nights, conferences, product launches — runs on a set menu so the finance team can sign off a per-head number weeks ahead. Whatever the format, the private corporate dinner package chef and team arrive briefed on your schedule, your guest count and any dietary needs in the group, so the food lands on cue, not whenever the kitchen happens to be ready.

add_block.new_heading: Choosing the best corporate dinner package catering in Dubai
new_paragraphs: The best corporate dinner package catering in Dubai for your event is the one matched to the room and the timing, not the one with the longest menu. A boardroom of ten with a two-hour window needs a plated menu that can be paced to the agenda. A department of eighty in a hired venue needs a format that serves everyone inside twenty minutes, which usually means a buffet or live stations rather than plated service.

Small party catering in Dubai works on the same logic at the other end of the scale: below about fifteen guests the service style matters more than the menu, because one server covers the room and the kitchen is whatever the venue has.

new_paragraphs: How much does corporate dinner package catering cost in Dubai?

It starts from around AED 700 per person and is quoted by headcount, menu and service level. Set packages are commonly quoted around AED 1,200 to 5,500, and regular or retained arrangements can be priced per programme.
What is included in a corporate dinner package?

Included is menu design, a vetted chef, service or delivery, table setup and clear-down, with optional bar and floor staff. It is a set package, so the price is agreed before the event, not tallied afterwards.
Can you build a fully halal or dietary-specific menu?

Yes — every corporate dinner package menu can be built fully halal on request, and vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut-free and allergy-aware plates are handled in the menu design. Tell us the dietary needs in your group and the chef plans around them.
Do you offer drop-off as well as full-service dinners?

We do both. Full service brings a chef and team who cook, plate and clear down on site; drop-off delivers the same menu ready to serve and lowers the cost by removing floor staff. Choose whichever suits the occasion.
Can you cater a large corporate event or gala dinner?

Yes — corporate dinner package catering for events scales from a boardroom of ten to a gala of several hundred, run on a set menu so your finance team can approve a per-head number in advance. Larger headcounts also lower the per-person rate.
Where in Dubai do you cater corporate dinners?

Across the whole city — DIFC, Business Bay, Downtown, the Marina, Jumeirah, Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills and beyond. If your venue is in Dubai, the chef and team come to you, so corporate dinner package catering near me is covered wherever your office or event space sits.
How quickly can you send a quote and confirm a booking?

We typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours and send a full itemised proposal, usually within one business day. Once you confirm the menu and headcount, we lock the chef and team and finalise the timing against your run of show.

add_block.new_heading: What does a corporate dinner package include?
new_paragraphs: A corporate dinner package includes a designed menu, a vetted chef, a service team and everything around the plate — so one line item covers the whole evening. That means menu design tailored to your headcount, plated or buffet service, table setup and clear-down, and optional bar and floor staff. Because it is a set package, not an open-ended bill, the cost is agreed up front and does not drift on the night. Most companies book this as a full-service arrangement — the corporate dinner package catering company brings the kitchen to your venue, cooks on site or delivers hot, and leaves the space as they found it. If you would keep it lean, a drop-off format lowers the price while keeping the same menu. Either way you are hiring one accountable corporate dinner package caterer, not stitching together a kitchen, a rental firm and a waiting agency yourself.
